  "assessment": "**Change summary**
The change replaces the `head | tail` pipeline with `sed -n "${start},${end}p"`, which natively supports inclusive line addressing and fixes the off-by-one error. It also adds a conditional guard to exit early when START exceeds END, preventing any ambiguous behavior from sed's range processing.

review.assessment:
**Change summary**
The change replaces the `head | tail` pipeline with `sed -n "${start},${end}p"`, which natively supports inclusive line addressing and fixes the off-by-one error. It also adds a conditional guard to exit early when START exceeds END, preventing any ambiguous behavior from sed's range processing.

**Defects found**
None. The logic correctly satisfies all stated edge cases (inclusive ranges, single-line requests, EOF boundaries) without introducing regressions. Since no defects were identified, the findings list is empty.
